ZORA 2.0 is still in beta. New features are being frequently added before being fully-tested, so some bugs are to be expected.
If you encounter a bug or issue, report it in the ZORA Discord with the text from the "Copy bug report info" button.

Zelda One Randomizer App

A newly re-imagined randomizer for The Legend of Zelda
Your ROM is read in this page only and is never uploaded

How will you play?
1

Get the ZORA world

Archipelago builds the multiworld from every player's YAML. It needs ZORA's world file, zora.apworld, and a PRG0 or PRG1 ROM on the computer that patches your game. This page only makes your YAML: no ROM is needed here.

zora.apworld
The download link appears once the page has loaded.
Setup guide
The Archipelago guide for ZORA: how to install the world, generate, host and play.
1

Select ROM

Legend of Zelda, The (USA), PRG0 or PRG1 release, as a .nes file.

2

Choose your settings

Starting from …. A teal dot marks a setting you changed. To use flags someone gave you, paste them into the strings below.
